func zzReport(t *testing.T, root string, args ...string) {
	var so, se bytes.Buffer
	code := cmdReport(root, append([]string{"--task", "probe"}, args...), &so, &se)
	raw, _ := os.ReadFile(strings.TrimSpace(so.String()))
	s := string(raw)
	if i := strings.Index(s, "## Files Changed"); i >= 0 {
		s = s[i:strings.Index(s, "## Validation Commands")]
	}
	t.Logf("report %v exit=%d stderr=%q MD=%q", args, code, se.String(), s)
}

func zzAll(t *testing.T, name, root, rev string) {
	var o bytes.Buffer
	c := &nativeChecker{root: root, mode: "strict", locale: localeEN, stdout: &o}
	c.readyTransitionCandidates()
	_, err := computeChangedScopeWith(root, rev, "", nil, scopeMetadata{})
	t.Logf("== %s\ncheck errors=%d %q\nscope: %v", name, c.errors, o.String(), err)
}

func zzGit(t *testing.T, root string, args ...string) string {
	out, _ := exec.Command("git", append([]string{"-C", root, "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@t"}, args...)...).CombinedOutput()
	return string(out)
}

func TestZZEntryCorruption(t *testing.T) {
	for _, v := range []string{"unordered", "entryformat", "warningfirst", "warningrev", "splitbroken", "splitmissing", "sig", "badconfig", "badhead"} {
		root, _ := staleIndexRepo(t)
		os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "zz.txt"), []byte("z\n"), 0o644)
		zzGit(t, root, "add", "zz.txt")
		idx := filepath.Join(root, ".git", "index")
		rev := "HEAD"
		switch v {
		case "unordered":
			// rename the first entry so that it sorts after the second
			raw, _ := os.ReadFile(idx)
			raw[12+62] = '~'
			os.WriteFile(idx, raw, 0o644)
		case "entryformat":
			raw, _ := os.ReadFile(idx)
			binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(raw[4:8], 3)
			raw[12+60] |= 0x40
			raw[12+62] = 0xff
			os.WriteFile(idx, raw, 0o644)
		case "warningfirst":
			zzGit(t, root, "config", "diff.dirstat", "bogus")
			os.WriteFile(idx, []byte(strings.Repeat("g", 200)), 0o644)
		case "warningrev":
			zzGit(t, root, "config", "diff.dirstat", "bogus")
			rev = "no-such-ref"
		case "splitbroken", "splitmissing":
			zzGit(t, root, "config", "core.splitIndex", "true")
			zzGit(t, root, "update-index", "--split-index")
			m, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root, ".git", "sharedindex.*"))
			if len(m) == 0 {
				t.Fatal("no shared")
			}
			for _, p := range m {
				if v == "splitmissing" {
					os.Remove(p)
					continue
				}
				raw, _ := os.ReadFile(p)
				raw[len(raw)-1] ^= 1
				os.Chmod(p, 0o644)
				os.WriteFile(p, raw, 0o644)
			}
		case "sig":
			os.WriteFile(idx, []byte(strings.Repeat("g", 200)), 0o644)
		case "badconfig":
			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, ".git", "config"), []byte("[core\n"), 0o644)
		case "badhead":
			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, ".git", "HEAD"), []byte("junk\n"), 0o644)
		}
		t.Logf("--- %s: plain git diff says %q", v, zzGit(t, root, "diff", "--name-only", rev, "--"))
		zzAll(t, v, root, rev)
		zzReport(t, root)
	}
}

func TestZZAbs(t *testing.T) {

	outside := t.TempDir()
	t.Setenv("GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES", filepath.Dir(outside))
	zzAll(t, "outside", outside, "HEAD")
}

Round 3 fixes the pt-BR silent report, but it introduces two medium regressions in how index failures are reported (N17, N18). Both break R2.

| ID | Location | Defect |

| N18 | `pose/git_worktree_reads.go:108` | The new pattern misses real index refusals, such as `unknown index entry format` and `broken index` for a shared index. Both are labelled `revision unknown?`; round 2's code marked them as index failures. |

## New low follow-ups

| ID | Location | Defect |
|---|---|---|
| N19 | `cli/report.go:309` | A broken `.git/config` or `HEAD` still gives a silent report saying `No files detected`. |
| N20 | `cli/validate_scope.go:112` | Failed index lookups are still labelled `revision unknown?`, and the `failed` prefix is repeated. |
| N21 | `pose/review_attempt_ledger.go:536` | Several guards still have no failing test, including the ledger's deadline and three of the English-locale settings. |
| N22 | `cli/report.go:312` | Absolute checkout paths still reach the versioned report. |

|---|---|

Round 3 fixes the pt-BR silent report, but it introduces two medium regressions in how index failures are reported (N17, N18). Both break R2.

## Blockers (paths under `pose-mcp/internal/`)

| ID | Location | Defect |
|---|---|---|
| N17 | `pose/git_worktree_reads.go:119` | Only Git's first error line is kept. If Git prints a warning first, the real cause is lost, a corrupt index is labelled `revision unknown?`, and a bad revision loses its `fatal:` line. Reproduced with `diff.dirstat=bogus`. |
| N18 | `pose/git_worktree_reads.go:108` | The new pattern misses real index refusals, such as `unknown index entry format` and `broken index` for a shared index. Both are labelled `revision unknown?`; round 2's code marked them as index failures. |

## New low follow-ups

| ID | Location | Defect |
|---|---|---|
| N19 | `cli/report.go:309` | A broken `.git/config` or `HEAD` still gives a silent report saying `No files detected`. |
| N20 | `cli/validate_scope.go:112` | Failed index lookups are still labelled `revision unknown?`, and the `failed` prefix is repeated. |
| N21 | `pose/review_attempt_ledger.go:536` | Several guards still have no failing test, including the ledger's deadline and three of the English-locale settings. |
| N22 | `cli/report.go:312` | Absolute checkout paths still reach the versioned report. |
